subject: Planned: EU-Central kernel sanitization + failover exercise — Aug 9 (UTC)
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@acme-corp.com>, Acme Cloud Ops <support+infra@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2027 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Planned: EU-Central kernel sanitization + failover exercise — Aug 9 (UTC)

Hi Alex / Acme team —

Heads up: we have a planned maintenance window in eu-central (Frankfurt) on Tue, Aug 9 starting at 09:00 UTC for a targeted kernel sanitization and a controlled failover exercise across a subset of inference pools. This is a proactive effort to remove a class of driver side-state that has caused intermittent tokenization stalls under high-concurrency profiles in the past.

Priority details:
- Window: 2027-08-09 09:00 — 11:00 UTC (2 hours)
- Scope: 3 node sub-pools in eu-central-1 (inference-pool-a, inference-pool-b, canary-pool-1)
- Expected customer impact: brief rolling reconnects (~5–20s) per affected replica during eviction/drain; streaming connections may reconnect and resume.
- Rollback: automatic fallback to warm spare instances and immediate traffic re-routing to unaffected pools in eu-west and us-east if we detect > 1% error spike or sustained latency degradation.

Mitigations we will apply:
- Staged draining with affinity-aware placement to avoid concurrent drains for the same tenancy.
- KV-cache priming for high-QPS tenants (including Acme) ahead of the window.
- Extra telemetry retention for the window (+72h) to support postmortem.

Attachments: runbook and impact matrix attached.

Ask from you: if Acme has any planned heavy inference jobs (long streaming sessions or batch writes) crossing Aug 9 09:00—11:00 UTC, let us know and we will schedule exclusions or shift them to the canary window.

I will be on the call during the window and will post updates to https://status.redwood.com/incidents/RE-2027-08-eu-central.

Thanks,
Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Site Reliability Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-eu-central-sanitization-runbook.pdf (PDF), impact-matrix-eu-central.csv (CSV)
